abstract: The World Economic Forum's Future of Jobs Report 2025 examines employer expectations regarding AI's impact on employment. The report finds that 40% of employers globally expect to reduce headcount due to AI automation, with net displacement estimates ranging from 5-14% of current roles by 2030.
keyFindings: 40% of employers globally expect to reduce headcount as AI automates tasks
